facts.fact: Data Protection Commission executive director Dr Arnold Kavaarpuo said the Ministry is developing specific regulations under the misinformation and disinformation bill to address misuse of AI-generated images and videos.
The Data Protection Commission is operating under an Executive Director, Dr Arnold Kavaarpuo, who launched Data Protection Week 2026 in Accra.
The Data Protection Commission's director referred to the Data Protection Act of 2012 as a current law.
The Data Protection Commission, headed by Executive Director Dr Arnold Kavaarpuo, is acting and launched Data Protection Week 2026.
The deputy minister said a Privacy campaign launched with the Commission in September 2025 reached millions through radio, television, print and online platforms.
